name: interactive-editor
description: An interactive editor in front of every file write. The model proposes; you edit the proposal by hand and decide whether it lands.

plugins.name: interactive-editor
plugins.description: Claude proposes a file write; you edit the proposal by hand and decide whether it lands. In hosts that render MCP Apps you get an editor and a live diff. In a terminal you get the diff as text — and, unless you opt in to --terminal-approval, no way to commit at all.
